name: Portal Market-Data Sourcing Strategy (YCharts vs Bloomberg-PKL vs SmartX)
description: Andrew-direct directive 2026-05-20 (CEO interview with 0.1.0_DS_MarketIntelligence + the ycharts.com.har 92MB capture). Goal: determine, surface by surface, which portal market-data surfaces currently fed by the manual Bloomberg pkl yang-pipeline could instead be sourced by a daily automated YCharts pull, and which must remain manual Bloomberg pkl -- the end-state is an explicit hybrid. Also evaluates whether model-portfolio performance is better sourced from YCharts /model_portfolios/*, the yang model.pkl, or the SmartX backend. Phase 0 = four parallel domain audits (WS-1 external market data / WS-2 portfolio analytics / WS-3 client-facing data) + an operational-pattern declaration (WS-4) + a live YCharts session test. Phase 1 = CTO synthesis -> migration decision matrix + integration architecture + phased implementation plan (PRD v0.3). Implementation (Phase 2) is charted by v0.3 and gated on the Andrew Q1/Q7 business calls.
phase: Phase 1 COMPLETE -- WS-5 SYNTHESIS SHIPPED. PRD v0.3 (implementation charter) SHIPPED 2026-05-20 (1.0.0_SA_CTO). All four Phase-0 audits + the live-session test consumed. MIGRATION DECISION MATRIX (32 surfaces): 7 YCharts-replaceable + 10 hybrid (YCharts feeds inputs, Opal keeps computation) = YCharts touches 17/32; 6 SmartX-sourced (incl. the model-portfolio performance manual-pkl->SmartX-REST upgrade); 6 proprietary + 1 Bloomberg-pkl-only (Opal model IP -- model_pkl + CMA/SAA workbooks, stay manual); 2 already on FRED (VIX, yield curve). Q4 ANSWERED: SmartX REST API = canonical model-portfolio performance source (model.pkl retained as the proprietary design view). INTEGRATION ARCHITECTURE: YCharts cookie-bundle operational pattern (WS-4) declared; CTO recommendation -- pursue the official YCharts Data API as primary (eliminates the single-session/WAF/capture/ToS risk), session-scrape as fallback. PHASED PLAN: Phase 2A capture-probe + Q1 (TO-A1); Phase 2B SmartX-REST model-perf pull, Q1-INDEPENDENT (TO-B1, co-scopes with SXPL_RESTIN); Phase 2C YCharts integration build, Q1-gated (TO-C1/C2); Phase 2D yang-pipeline cutover (TO-D1). PHASE 2 DECOMPOSED 2026-05-20 (2.0.0_SA_COO): 5 implementation TOs committed -- YALP_MDSRC.A1 (capture probe, AE 0.7.0), .B1 (SmartX-REST model-perf pull, DS 0.4.0; internal SXPL_RESTIN-auth-reuse coordination), .C1 (YCharts credential pipeline, AE 0.7.0; Q1-branched), .C2 (YCharts market-data pull, DS 0.1.0+0.2.0), .D1 (yang cutover, AE 0.5.0+DS). TO-5 (WS-5 synthesis) RAVC4-CLOSED. A1 + B1 GO'd 2026-05-20 (Q1-independent; v0.3 confirmed on origin/CLOUD de7facf93+c3c04bc9d). C1/C2 staged on Andrew Q1/Q7; D1 staged on Phase 2C. Andrew-direct: DS 0.1.0 running a 5h comprehensive YCharts capability exhaustion -- master brief feeds v0.4/Q1.
blocking: None for the dispatched work -- A1 (capture probe) + B1 (SmartX-REST model-perf pull) GO'd 2026-05-20, Q1-independent. Phase 2C (TO-C1/C2 YCharts integration build) GATES on the Andrew Q1 (official API vs session-scrape -- CTO recommends official API) + Q7 (ToS) business calls.
